description.value:
REO's armoured meatwagons will haul you off any corner. Calling them takes an Action; they arrive in 1d12 rounds in combat, ten minutes otherwise.

  • Paramedics stabilize you with cryopumps; no Surgery and no cryotank storage.
  • You stay in stasis until healed at your natural rate, at 200eb per day of recovery.
  • Addiction Therapy is available at REO's affiliated facilities (at its cost).
  • They're not reliable: they may pad the bill, extort you, or leave if it gets too hot.

Needs a Generic PrePak lifestyle or better; it's cancelled if you drop below. Bought mid-month, it starts on rent day.

Health plan: 250eb a month.
